_comment: MSP-B1 offline configuration fixture for the native AWS Event Connector (discovery/ingest/aws_events_config.py). Mirrors azure_events_config_sample.json: NON-SECRET config only — the managed-account estate, its partition, each account's read-only role ARN / STS ExternalId / regions. No AWS access key ever appears here or in AWS_EVENT_ACCOUNTS; the hub key lives in the per-org credential vault under the connector id 'aws_events' and per-account direct keys under 'aws_events:account:{account_id}'. LIVE DATA NEEDED: replace account_id / role_arn / external_id / regions with the customer's real managed accounts before a live run, and vault the hub access key through the Integration Hub AWS card.
